The EV/EBITDA 20.5x at the 8th percentile of its own 9.2y range looks cheap-vs-history, but this is a trailing-only figure with no forward basis and its own median (43.3x) reflects a de-rating from a far higher regime — the near-floor reading is the consensus MISREAD unless one can distinguish a temporarily depressed level from a permanently reset one.
